propositions: On final structured-parse failure in _pai_structured's prompted reask loop, when llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir is set to a non-empty path, write a timestamped artifact containing the raw reply text, model id, contract name, and attempt count to that directory before raising the error.
The llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir key is a new optional field on LLMConfig resolved via _llm_str in from_env with CLI > env > file > default precedence, defaulting to None (no artifact writes).

Artifact write is best-effort and best-effort only: I/O errors are swallowed and the original parse error is raised unchanged; the directory is created if absent; at most 20 artifacts per directory are retained by mtime-based pruning.
With the key unset, the failure path behavior and error message are byte-for-byte unchanged from today's baseline.
